title: Newsroom tabs still read whole tables: Reference and ReferenceAttachment in loadEditorFullNewsDeskDashboard
description: Desks, Topics, Concepts and Administration load every Reference and every ReferenceAttachment through listUserPoolModel (components/news-desk-taxonomy-client.ts loadEditorFullNewsDeskDashboard). They should read what they show. Also the List view reads every Reference when opened (loadAllEditorReferences); page it by status index. Found on PPY-c8cb44.
